purpose: One deterministic customer-session kernel owns kiosk readiness, intentional system handoffs, idle abandonment, safe reset, recovery and bounded runtime evidence across every vessel.

transitions.ready_to_active: Customer begins or resumes a vessel workflow.
transitions.active_to_handoff: Intentional OS/browser passage such as camera, photo picker, file picker or future payment sheet.
transitions.handoff_to_active: Return preserves the exact active customer place and restarts the idle clock.
transitions.active_to_safe_reset: Only verified idle abandonment or expired handoff may purge transient customer cargo.
transitions.recovering_to_ready: Fresh runtime recovery returns to exact-vessel safe home; it never restores privileged authority.

release_gate: Camera/photo-picker round trip must preserve active customer state; configured idle abandonment must still purge to exact-vessel safe home.
